pages.text: $(l)Flax$() is the mod's home-grown fibre. Plant $(l)Flax Seeds$() on farmland and harvest the mature crop for flax.

Spin flax into $(l)Flax String$() — a fast, cheap bowstring — so you never have to hunt spiders just to string a bow. It draws a touch shaky if you overhold, but the $(l)Aim$() skill smooths that out.
